title: wrenfell 目标现场数据架构决策
domain: 计算机与信息系统经理
role: 计算机与信息系统经理
instruction:
您是信息系统经理，支持 Wrenfell Geoenvironmental 启动 Sheafield Mutual 修复框架，Malachy Oyelaran 需要在技术保证审查前确定目标现场数据架构。该框架运行四年，现场采样将于 3 2月 2027 开始。在第一批动员中，十二个班组将在十八个前工业场地工作，通常每三到十天搬迁一次。Sheafield 的覆盖调查发现在其中十四个场地没有可靠的蜂窝服务，另外四个场地服务间歇性可用。因此，Chidi Macaulay 的现场团队期望在没有 WAN 连接的情况下，在整个班次期间持续记录样本和保管链转移。Sheafield 的信息处理时间表同时规定，样本标识符、位置、观察结果和保管链记录不得静止存储在终端用户设备上。其安全澄清仅允许在具有加密和访问日志记录的经批准的托管基础设施中进行持久化存储。车队由二十台受管理的平板电脑和二十八台无法注册到 Wrenfell 移动设备管理服务的个人拥有的 Android 和 iPad 设备组成。通信文件在操作和安全讨论中都使用了“离线”一词，但并非所有人都用它来表示相同的含义，因此审查团队需要确切了解拟议架构在使用该术语时承诺了什么。源材料收集在 `field_architecture_correspondence.pdf` 中；将其作为决策的事实记录，包括政策措辞、利益相关者立场、地产详情、接口能力和交付假设。Cecilia Gasparyan 要求直接从平板电脑提交至实验室，因为她认为这消除了一个集成层，而 Kamil Dimitrov 警告说，Drakemoor Supply 实验室系统的许可证最多只允许两个并发外部 API 会话，并且会话保持占用状态直到其批次被确认。Drakemoor 支持排队批量提交和状态检索，但其协议不包括为每个班组提供单独的连接。Maren Guerrero 还需要保管事件在网络中断期间保持可归因性和防篡改性，因为记录以后可能在规划调查中出示；仅在重新连接后创建的收据本身无法解释断开期间谁持有样本。Sheafield 要求事件时间为 UTC 且精确到一秒，但源文件指出平板电脑时钟可由用户更改，且现场位置在中断期间没有保证的时间服务。实施窗口也受到限制。两名集成工程师在动员前各有六周可用时间，安全架构师可提供八天的审查时间，从 21 12月到 5 1月有变更冻结期。通信中的估计表明，新的原生跨平台采集应用程序超出了该容量，即使是在验证之前，而如果架构能够合理地利用它们，现有的经批准的托管边缘镜像和当前的基于浏览器的现场表单可以在所述窗口内配置。这些是规划假设，而不是忽略测试、运营支持或故障处理的许可。目标必须涵盖从现场采集到 Drakemoor 实验室系统接受接收的全过程，包括伴随该流程的保管证据。它必须在混合车队上工作，而不将个人拥有的平板电脑视为托管基础设施，尊重两会话实验室限制，并为调查团队提供不依赖于信任用户可调平板电脑时钟的完整性证据。几种安排在技术上都是可构建的，但 Malachy 希望得到一个有限的决定，而不是可能性的目录。他还希望被拒绝的设计与选定的目标明显分开，以便审查者可以看到为什么看似更简单的选择未被推进。该文档应将选择转化为通过动员的可执行路线图，使用通信实际支持的人员、容量、日期和系统边界。根据源文件中的假设预测未来结果，并在不确定性影响计划时明确说明。不要发明源文件未提供的成本、人员配置、吞吐量、可用性百分比、保留期限、接口能力或供应商承诺。产品采购和商业重新谈判不在本决策范围内，文档不应选择或暗示认可新的命名产品。为 Malachy 和技术保证审查员准备 `target_field_data_architecture.docx`。总页数不超过八页，包括图表、表格和附录，并使其作为决策和交付文档可读，而不是消息的转录。它必须包含一个具体的推荐架构、搁置的设计和实施路线图，并在推荐和路线图引用规模或容量的任何地方一致地使用单一数值规划基线。以架构决策本身结束，而不是以问题列表或通用下一步行动结束。使用确切的文件名 `target_field_data_architecture.docx` 将文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述提到的文件位于 `references/` 中：

- `references/field_architecture_correspondence.pdf` — 合并的利益相关者通信，包含控制政策语言、现场条件、车队事实、实验室接口约束、资源估算、日期以及用于架构决策的利益相关者立场。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下确切的文件名：

- `target_field_data_architecture.docx` — 一份同行可评审的目标现场数据架构决策和可执行实施路线图，涵盖从现场采集到实验室接受接收的过程。（顶层工作目录文件；包括图表、表格和附录在内最多八页；恰好一个推荐架构；被拒绝的设计明显分开；一个一致的数值规划基线；无发明的数字或新命名产品选择；结论以决策结束。）

除这些文件名外，不收集任何其他内容。在其他任何位置或以其他任何名称编写的正确文件得零分。

materials.text:
Sheafield Mutual: field data architecture correspondence
Consolidated messages • 18 November–10 December 2026 • Internal working record


18 Nov 2026 | Malachy Oyelaran, Technical Assurance
Please settle a bounded target before assurance review. The remediation framework is four years; field sampling
begins 3 February 2027. First mobilisation is 12 crews across 18 former industrial sites, moving every three to ten
days. We need a decision from field entry through accepted Drakemoor receipt, not a technology catalogue.

19 Nov 2026 | Chidi Macaulay, Field Operations
Coverage survey: 14 sites have no dependable cellular service; the other 4 are intermittent. By “offline” the crews
mean they can capture samples and custody transfers throughout a full shift with no WAN. We have 20 managed
tablets and 28 personally owned Android/iPad devices. The personally owned devices cannot be enrolled in
Wrenfell MDM.

20 Nov 2026 | Sheafield information handling schedule (quoted by Maren Guerrero)
“Sample identifiers, locations, observations and chain-of-custody records must not be stored at rest on an end-user
device.” Security clarification: persistence is permitted only in approved managed infrastructure with encryption and
access logging. Note that security colleagues have also used “offline” to mean no persistent sample data on a tablet;
this is not the field usage.

23 Nov 2026 | Cecilia Gasparyan, Programme Sponsor
I prefer each tablet submitting straight to Drakemoor. Removing an integration tier looks simpler. This is a preference;
please test it against the interface agreement and field conditions.

24 Nov 2026 | Kamil Dimitrov, Laboratory Integration
Drakemoor Supply permits no more than two concurrent external API sessions. A session remains occupied until
its submitted batch is acknowledged. It supports queued batch submission and status retrieval. The agreement does
not include a separate connection per crew.

27 Nov 2026 | Maren Guerrero, Digital Evidence
Custody may be produced in a planning inquiry. Every event needs sample identity, responsible actor, action/transfer
and event time. A receipt made only after reconnection cannot, by itself, explain disconnected possession. Sheafield
requires UTC to one-second resolution. Tablet clocks are user-changeable and no external time service is guaranteed
while a site is out.

3 Dec 2026 | Delivery Office
Before mobilisation, two integration engineers are available for six weeks each; the security architect has eight review
days. Change freeze: 21 December–5 January. The current browser-based field form and an existing approved
managed-edge image can be configured in the window if used defensibly. A new native cross-platform capture
application is beyond capacity even before validation.

10 Dec 2026 | Malachy Oyelaran
No procurement or commercial renegotiation in this decision. Do not infer costs, throughput, availability, retention,
extra vendor connections or other commitments. Make failure handling, testing and operational support explicit.


Compiled from email and assurance-message excerpts; wording retained where it establishes a constraint or stakeholder position.

gold.text:
TARGET FIELD-DATA ARCHITECTURE
Sheafield Mutual remediation framework | Decision for Malachy Oyelaran and technical assurance
Decision at a glance
Approve one target: a managed field edge is the disconnected system of record. Managed and personally owned tablets are browser-only presentation/input endpoints to that local edge; they do not persist sample, location, observation or custody data. The edge synchronizes to Wrenfell central integration, which verifies the custody sequence and alone submits queued batches to Drakemoor through a maximum of two acknowledgement-held sessions.
Planning baseline
Decision use
Framework / start
Four years; sampling starts 3 February 2027
First wave
12 crews, 18 sites; moves every 3–10 days
Coverage
14 sites no dependable cellular; 4 intermittent
Fleet
20 managed tablets; 28 BYOD Android/iPad, not MDM-enrollable
Lab boundary
At most 2 concurrent external API sessions; held until batch acknowledgement
Delivery envelope
2 integration engineers × 6 weeks; security architect 8 review days; freeze 21 Dec–5 Jan

Scope, terms and decision criteria
Scope is field capture, custody evidence, synchronization and accepted Drakemoor receipt. Procurement and commercial renegotiation are excluded. “Operationally offline” means the crew can capture and record custody for a full shift without WAN. It does not mean data may be stored on a tablet. Under the schedule, persistent disconnected records can exist only on approved managed infrastructure, encrypted and access-logged.
Decision criteria: preserve field work under WAN loss; keep end-user devices out of the persistence trust boundary; produce inquiry-ready, attributable custody evidence; obey the two-session laboratory agreement; and fit configuration/integration inside the stated window.
Accountabilities
Accountable
Decision / delivery responsibility
Malachy Oyelaran
Architecture approval, assurance gates and readiness decision
Chidi Macaulay
Field workflow acceptance and pilot custody rehearsal
Maren Guerrero
Evidence, time and integrity assurance review
Kamil Dimitrov
Drakemoor interface coordination and acknowledgement test
Cecilia Gasparyan
Programme sponsor; receives readiness outcome
Integration engineers
Configuration, central integration, queue and test evidence



Selected target: managed-edge, browser-only field capture
One architecture is selected. Each active field location uses the existing approved managed-edge image as managed infrastructure. Its encrypted, access-logged local store is the only disconnected store. The current browser field form is configured to use the edge over a local field network; neither managed tablets nor BYOD are a system of record, custody authority or privileged trust anchor.
UNMANAGED / END-USER ZONE
MANAGED FIELD INFRASTRUCTURE
WRENFELL CENTRAL SERVICES
DRAKEMOOR SUPPLY
20 managed tablets + 28 BYOD
Browser input only
No durable sample/custody data
No master keys
Approved managed-edge image
Encrypted access-logged store
Validation • controlled time
append-only signed/hash-chained ledger
Sync verifier + central anchor
Conflict/quarantine store
Durable lab queue
Two bounded session workers
External API
Queued batch submission
Status retrieval
Batch acknowledgement

Flow: ① actor signs into a short-lived browser session and scans/enters the stable sample identifier; ② browser sends over protected local transport to the edge; ③ edge locally accepts or rejects the record, creates custody evidence and returns status; ④ when WAN exists, edge sends idempotently to central verification; ⑤ central queues a lab batch; ⑥ one of at most two workers keeps its session allocated until acknowledgement, then records accepted receipt/status. All network boundaries use protected transport.
Endpoint, identity and trust controls
Browser configuration must disable application cache/offline storage, downloads/exports, form autofill and saved credentials; prevent persistence of temporary files where the browser/OS permits; clear session data on logout; and be validated by device inspection on managed and BYOD representatives. The edge must reject any client mode that needs local durable storage.
BYOD is confined to an unprivileged browser role. It receives only the active screen and short-lived session; no reusable integration credential, edge administration capability, signing material or custody authority is resident solely on it. A separate authenticated actor action is recorded for each custody event; reauthenticate after configured inactivity, handover, or a device loss report.
Edge, central service and laboratory integration use distinct least-privilege service identities. Encryption at rest applies to the edge, central evidence store, conflict/quarantine store and laboratory queue. Keys/credentials are provisioned to managed components, rotated/replaced and revocable; loss triggers revocation and recovery without putting master secrets on BYOD.


Record, custody and time design
Object
Required content and control
Sample
Stable capture identifier (barcode/label scan where available); never renumber at a boundary. Required field checks and format/range checks occur at edge before local acceptance.
Custody event
Stable event ID; sample ID; authenticated responsible actor; action or transfer; UTC timestamp to one-second resolution; prior-event reference; integrity value; time-confidence indicator.
Immediate vs central validation
Edge enforces required fields, permitted actions, ID shape and workflow completeness. Central checks cross-site/duplicate/conflicting states and lab schema readiness. Incomplete or central-invalid records cannot silently progress: retain in exception/quarantine with owner.
Lifecycle
Locally accepted → centrally synchronized/verified → submitted to lab → acknowledged by lab. Rejected, conflict and acknowledgement-unavailable states remain visible—not reported as success.

Trusted time and tamper evidence
The managed edge—not the tablet clock—stamps event time in UTC at one-second resolution. Before departure and whenever service is available, the edge obtains a controlled time reference and records its time-confidence/drift state. During a WAN outage it continues from that controlled local basis; if confidence is degraded or a permitted drift bound is exceeded, it records the uncertainty, alerts the field workflow and requires controlled reconciliation. Upload time never replaces original event time.
Before reconnection, the edge appends each custody event to an append-only sequence linked to its predecessor and protected with edge-held signing/integrity material. Central synchronization verifies sequence continuity and integrity, retains the original history, and independently anchors the verified sequence/receipt. This makes later alteration or deletion detectable; it does not prove an observation was true, physical possession occurred as asserted, or an authorized actor did not misuse credentials.
Synchronization, conflicts and evidence export
Each sample, event and synchronization envelope has a stable identifier. The edge retries safely after a timeout; central acknowledgement is keyed to those identifiers so retransmission converges on one logical sample and one custody sequence. Non-mergeable versions, sequence breaks, rejected updates and schema failures preserve both evidence and enter controlled conflict/quarantine resolution—never last-write-wins. Evidence export packages the custody history, integrity/anchor verification, sync receipts, time-confidence records, laboratory statuses and exception-resolution trail for inquiry without relying on a field device.


Laboratory control and operational failure behavior
Central integration owns every Drakemoor connection. A durable central queue applies back-pressure so accepted field records remain controlled while the laboratory is slow or unavailable. Exactly two bounded workers may hold external sessions; a worker does not release capacity when it transmits a batch, only when the matching acknowledgement/status settles the batch. This topology prevents 12 crews from creating concurrent external API sessions.
Condition
Required behavior / accountable owner
No WAN through full shift
Edge continues local acceptance, ledger and local status; browser remains non-persistent. Synchronization waits. Field lead follows custody procedure.
WAN returns / sync timeout
Retry idempotently; central verifies sequence and anchors it. Uncertain receipt stays “locally accepted” or “synchronized” until confirmed. Integration engineers monitor exceptions.
Delayed/unavailable lab acknowledgement
Batch remains queued/submitted; its worker session stays occupied until acknowledgement. Other work is buffered, never represented as accepted. Kamil coordinates interface response.
Lab schema/validation failure
Central retains payload and receipt evidence in quarantine; named integration engineer resolves with Kamil, then submits a controlled corrected/referenced update.
Integrity, time-confidence or conflict failure
Stop automatic progression; preserve original sequence and exception evidence. Maren directs evidence disposition; Malachy accepts/rejects readiness impact.
Lost BYOD or crew handover
Revoke browser session; actor reauthenticates on an available endpoint. No durable field record or master secret is recovered from the BYOD device.

Projected outcomes and explicit limits
Under the supplied coverage assumption, a crew can record a normal full disconnected shift at the managed edge, later obtaining verified central synchronization and then a distinct laboratory-acknowledged state. Under prolonged WAN loss, records remain locally accepted and inquiry evidence remains at the managed edge; central/lab status is delayed, not inferred. Under delayed lab acknowledgement, the central queue retains work and the two occupied sessions constrain dispatch; field capture continues independently. These are behavioral projections, not throughput or availability commitments.
Uncertainty to resolve during assurance: permitted managed-edge time-confidence/drift threshold, browser controls achievable on the actual BYOD variants, and Drakemoor’s exact response/error examples. These are validation inputs, not alternate target architectures or vendor commitments.


Designs set aside — not part of the target
Set-aside design
Why it is not carried forward
Cloud-only browser capture
Requires live WAN to record the field event; incompatible with 14 sites without dependable coverage, four intermittent sites, and full-shift disconnected operation.
Direct tablet-to-lab / per-crew connections
Cecilia’s simplification preference conflicts with a limit of two concurrent external API sessions for 12 crews. Sessions remain occupied until batch acknowledgement, so individual connections are neither licensed nor controllable.
Offline-first native tablet application with durable local store
Conflicts with the policy prohibition on identifiers, locations, observations and custody records at rest on end-user devices. A new native cross-platform build is also estimated beyond available delivery capacity before validation.
Treating BYOD as managed infrastructure
BYOD cannot join Wrenfell MDM and cannot inherit privileged trust, durable storage or custody authority.
Central receipt as the only custody evidence
A later receipt cannot explain disconnected possession or preserve event-time integrity during the outage.

Constraint-to-target trace
Material source constraint
Target response / stated limitation
WAN loss; full shift
Managed edge holds encrypted records and ledger; endpoint browser does not.
No data at rest on end-user device
Persistence only in approved edge/central stores; cache/download/autofill/temp-path controls tested.
Mixed 20 managed / 28 BYOD fleet
All are browser endpoints; BYOD has unprivileged, short-lived access only.
Custody/inquiry and UTC seconds
Edge creates actor/action/sample/time evidence, chained before WAN; time confidence is recorded.
Two lab sessions, acknowledgement-held
Central durable queue and no-more-than-two workers; submitted is distinct from acknowledged.
12 engineer-weeks; 8 review days; freeze
Configure existing browser form and approved edge, then integrate/test around freeze; no greenfield native build.
Limit of integrity claim
Detects sequence alteration/deletion; does not prove factual truth or prevent authorised credential misuse.



Delivery roadmap to mobilisation
The roadmap consumes no more than the available 12 integration engineer-weeks and eight security-architect review days. Dates below are planning dates derived from the fixed freeze and 3 February 2027 start; production change is not scheduled during the freeze.
Dates
Milestone / dependency
Accountable owner
Capacity / exit evidence
14–18 Dec
Assurance baseline and target specification; precedes configuration
Malachy; Maren
Security review days 1–2; target/control trace agreed
21 Dec–5 Jan
Change freeze: no production change; prepare review material only
Malachy
No deployment; open decisions logged for post-freeze
6–15 Jan
Configure browser form + approved managed edge; define IDs, ledger/time fields and local checks
Integration engineers
4 engineer-weeks; configured build ready for integration
11–20 Jan
Build central verification, idempotent sync, queue and two-session lifecycle; depends on field contract
Integration engineers; Kamil
5 engineer-weeks; interface/status evidence
18–22 Jan
Security/evidence review and remediate; depends on configured controls
Maren
Security review days 3–8; cache/storage, keys, time, ledger review
25–27 Jan
Bounded field pilot/rehearsal; depends on integration and review
Chidi; Maren
2 engineer-weeks support; pass evidence and field sign-off
28–29 Jan
Readiness / go-no-go and controlled release; depends on pilot
Malachy; Cecilia
1 engineer-week support; readiness before 3 Feb
1–2 Feb
Crew briefing, operational handover and mobilisation check
Chidi; Malachy
No feature change; custody fallback confirmed

Pilot acceptance and fallback
Prove in rehearsal
Observable pass evidence
Disconnected capture / no tablet persistence
Full-shift WAN simulation accepts records at edge; device inspection finds no sample/custody data in browser cache, downloads, autofill, app/temp paths or saved credentials.
Attribution, time and integrity
Actor/action/sample/UTC-second fields present; tablet clock change does not set authority; time-confidence degradation is visible; alteration/deletion breaks verification before reconnection.
Retry, conflict and lab boundary
Timeout retry creates no duplicate sample/event; non-mergeable update quarantines; concurrent dispatch never exceeds two acknowledgement-held sessions; delayed acknowledgement remains visible.
Go/no-go and fallback
Go only when all evidence passes and Malachy accepts. If not, do not release the target: use controlled existing custody procedure and retain paper/physical custody evidence for later controlled entry, preserving original dates/actors and exception record; no unverified electronic custody claim is substituted.



Assurance release statement
This decision deliberately uses available, approved components: configuration of the current browser field form and approved managed-edge image, plus bounded central integration. It does not assume a new product, a new vendor commitment, an extra laboratory connection, a universal device-management capability, or an unsupported performance figure. Readiness is conditional on the pilot evidence and the named reviews; the selected target does not conceal failure states behind upload or lab-submission timestamps.
Architecture decision
For the Sheafield Mutual first-wave baseline of 12 crews across 18 sites, Wrenfell will implement the managed-edge, browser-only field-data architecture described here: the approved managed edge is the encrypted, access-logged disconnected system of record and creates controlled, tamper-evident custody evidence; tablets, including BYOD, remain non-persistent unprivileged endpoints; Wrenfell central integration verifies and anchors synchronization and queues laboratory traffic through no more than two acknowledgement-held Drakemoor API sessions. This is the single target architecture for mobilisation readiness before field sampling on 3 February 2027.

original.grader_hint: Render the DOCX using a standard office renderer and count every page.

criteria.description: 文档定位为面向 Malachy Oyelaran 和技术保证同行的决策和交付工件，而不是转录稿或一般技术文章。
criteria.evidence: 目的陈述、文档结构和语气。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找适合同行保证的、可立即识别的决策、范围和实施导向。

original.criterion: The document is framed as a decision and delivery artifact for Malachy Oyelaran and technical assurance peers rather than as a transcript or general technology essay.
original.evidence: Purpose statement, document structure and tone.
original.grader_hint: Look for an immediately identifiable decision, scope and implementation orientation suitable for peer assurance.

criteria.description: 文档做出恰好一个目标架构推荐，且不留下两个或更多并列或有条件共同推荐的替代方案。
criteria.evidence: 推荐语言和结论语言。
criteria.grader_hint: 统计呈现为选定目标的架构数量。单个架构内的变体仅在不产生竞争性目标状态时可接受。

original.criterion: The document makes exactly one target architecture recommendation and does not leave two or more alternatives tied or conditionally co-recommended.
original.grader_hint: Count architectures presented as the selected target. Variants within one architecture are acceptable only if they do not create competing target states.

criteria.description: 最后的实质性段落以明确的架构决策结束，而不是问题、通用的下一步行动列表或请求他人进行选择。
criteria.evidence: 最后一节和最后一段。
criteria.grader_hint: 孤立地阅读结尾并验证审查者能否陈述决定了什么。

original.criterion: The final substantive passage ends on an unambiguous architecture decision rather than questions, a generic next-step list or a request for someone else to choose.
original.grader_hint: Read the ending in isolation and verify that a reviewer can state what was decided.

criteria.description: 在依赖“离线”一词之前，文档确定了其操作含义，并将该含义与终端用户设备上缺乏持久化样本数据区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 定义、假设或架构叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 接受等效术语，但文本必须消除在无 WAN 访问情况下操作与在平板电脑上存储记录之间的歧义。

original.criterion: Before relying on the word “offline,” the document pins down its operational meaning and distinguishes that meaning from absence of persistent sample data on an end-user device.
original.grader_hint: Accept equivalent terminology, but the text must remove the ambiguity between operating without WAN access and storing records on a tablet.

criteria.description: 选定的架构支持在整个 WAN 中断期间进行现场采集和保管记录，同时防止样本和保管记录静止存储在受管理或个人拥有的平板电脑上。
criteria.evidence: 选定的数据流、组件职责和断开状态行为。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪一条在无 WAN 情况下创建的记录。它必须离开或避免持久的平板存储，并通过符合要求的架构组件保持对现场工作流程可用。

original.criterion: The selected architecture supports field capture and custody recording during a full WAN outage while still preventing sample and custody records from persisting at rest on managed or personally owned tablets.
original.evidence: Selected data flow, component responsibilities and disconnected-state behavior.
original.grader_hint: Trace a record created with no WAN. It must leave or avoid durable tablet storage and remain available to the field workflow through a compliant architecture component.

criteria.description: 任何持久保存断开样本数据的组件都明确被视为经批准的托管基础设施，而不是终端用户设备。
criteria.evidence: 信任边界图和组件描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证持久本地存储仅分配给具有合理政策分类的受管理组件。

original.criterion: Any component that persistently holds disconnected sample data is explicitly treated as approved managed infrastructure rather than as an end-user device.
original.grader_hint: Verify that persistent local storage is assigned only to a managed component with a defensible policy classification.

criteria.description: 架构使无静止数据要求在浏览器和操作系统行为方面可信，解决本地缓存、下载、自动填充、临时文件或等效持久化路径，而不是仅依赖政策声明。
criteria.evidence: 端点控制和验证要求。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找对常见客户端持久化通道的具体技术处理以及验证该处理的方法。

original.criterion: The architecture makes the no-data-at-rest requirement credible for browser and operating-system behavior, addressing local caches, downloads, autofill, temporary files or equivalent persistence paths rather than relying only on a policy statement.
original.grader_hint: Look for concrete technical treatment of common client-side persistence channels and a way to verify the treatment.

criteria.description: 个人拥有的设备仅限于不需要 MDM 注册、特权信任或被归类为托管基础设施的角色。
criteria.evidence: BYOD 信任模型和访问设计。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪 BYOD 平板电脑的特权和数据暴露；它绝不能静默继承仅在 Wrenfell 管理的平板电脑上可用的控制措施。

original.criterion: Personally owned devices are confined to a role that does not require MDM enrollment, privileged trust or classification as managed infrastructure.
original.evidence: BYOD trust model and access design.
original.grader_hint: Trace the privileges and data exposure of a BYOD tablet; it must not silently inherit controls available only on Wrenfell-managed tablets.

criteria.description: 设计包括针对共享现场条件的适度会话、身份验证和重新身份验证行为，而不将可重复使用的秘密或保管权限 solely 放在 BYOD 设备上。
criteria.evidence: 身份和会话控制描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估当设备共享、丢失或通过断开班次使用时，行为者归属是否仍然有意义。

original.criterion: The design includes proportionate session, authentication and reauthentication behavior for shared field conditions without placing reusable secrets or custody authority solely on a BYOD device.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether actor attribution remains meaningful when devices are shared, lost or used through a disconnected shift.

criteria.description: 样本身份通过使用稳定标识符和条形码或标签扫描等实用机制，在采集、保管事件和实验室提交过程中得以维持，无需未经支持的重新编号。
criteria.evidence: 逻辑数据流和身份控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 跟踪一个样本跨越每个边界，并验证其身份可以在无需手动重新解释的情况下进行协调。

original.criterion: Sample identity is maintained through capture, custody events and laboratory submission using a stable identifier and a practical mechanism such as barcode or label scanning, without unsupported renumbering.
original.evidence: Logical data flow and identity controls.
original.grader_hint: Follow one sample across every boundary and verify that its identity can be reconciled without manual reinterpretation.

criteria.description: 现场验证区分必须立即检查的数据与依赖实验室或中央服务的验证，防止无效或不完整的记录静默推进。
criteria.evidence: 验证和异常处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找在断开情况下的合理验证以及对尚不能通过中央检查的记录的明确处理。

original.criterion: Field validation distinguishes data that must be checked immediately from validation that depends on laboratory or central services, with invalid or incomplete records prevented from silently progressing.
original.grader_hint: Look for defensible validation under disconnection and explicit handling of records that cannot yet pass central checks.

criteria.description: 每个保管事件至少保留样本身份、负责行为者、保管动作或转移以及事件时间。
criteria.evidence: 保管事件模型或架构叙述。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证事件内容能否回答谁拥有什么、发生了什么变化以及何时发生。

original.criterion: Each custody event preserves, at minimum, the sample identity, responsible actor, custody action or transfer, and event time.
original.evidence: Custody event model or architecture narrative.
original.grader_hint: Verify that the event content can answer who had what, what changed and when.

criteria.description: 在整个选定流程中，保管事件时间以源文件要求的 UTC 一秒分辨率表示。
criteria.evidence: 时间戳规范和数据流注释。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认 UTC 和一秒分辨率，并检查后续转换不会削弱它们。

original.criterion: Custody event times are represented in UTC at the source-required one-second resolution throughout the selected flow.
original.grader_hint: Confirm both UTC and one-second resolution and check that later transformations do not weaken them.

criteria.description: 时间戳设计不将用户可调的平板电脑时钟视为权威来源。
criteria.evidence: 可信时间设计和保管事件创建流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 权威事件时间必须来自受控源或与受控源有合理关联，而不仅仅是复制平板电脑时钟。

original.criterion: The timestamp design does not treat a user-adjustable tablet clock as authoritative.
original.evidence: Trusted-time design and custody-event creation flow.
original.grader_hint: The authoritative event time must come from, or be defensibly related to, a controlled source rather than merely copying the tablet clock.

criteria.description: 架构解决了时钟漂移和中断期间外部时间服务丢失的问题，包括如何记录而非隐藏不确定性或校正。
criteria.evidence: 时间控制、监控和协调描述。
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找受控的本地时间基准、漂移检测或界限，以及当时间置信度降低时的可审计响应。

original.criterion: The architecture addresses clock drift and loss of an external time service during an outage, including how uncertainty or correction is recorded rather than concealed.
original.grader_hint: Look for a controlled local time basis, drift detection or bounds, and an auditable response when time confidence is degraded.

criteria.description: 在广域网重新连接之前，使用仅追加、链式、签名或等效可辩护的完整性机制，使断连期间的保管事件具备防篡改证据。
criteria.evidence: 保管账本或完整性控制说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 该机制必须能够暴露离线事件的篡改或删除；仅依靠普通数据库权限是不够的。

original.criterion: Disconnected custody events are made tamper-evident before WAN reconnection using an append-only, chained, signed or equivalently defensible integrity mechanism.
original.grader_hint: The mechanism must expose alteration or deletion of offline events; ordinary database permissions alone are insufficient.

criteria.description: 文档准确界定了防篡改证据所证明的范围，并未将其等同于观察结果真实或无授权人员滥用凭据的证明。
criteria.evidence: 保证声明与局限性。
criteria.grader_hint: 明确认可围绕完整性、身份和事实准确性所设定的技术上准确的边界。

original.criterion: The document accurately limits what tamper evidence proves and does not equate it with proof that an observation was true or that no authorized person misused credentials.
original.grader_hint: Credit explicit, technically accurate boundaries around integrity, identity and factual accuracy.

criteria.description: 重新连接提供独立的中央锚点、回执或对断连期间完整性序列的验证，同时保留原始事件历史。
criteria.evidence: 同步与验证流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 确认重新连接是对现有事件进行验证和锚定，而不是用上传时间替换其原始时间。

original.criterion: Reconnection provides an independent central anchor, receipt or verification of the disconnected integrity sequence while preserving the original event history.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that reconnection verifies and anchors existing events rather than replacing their times with upload times.

criteria.description: 同步设计支持重试安全，防止重传产生重复样本或重复保管事件。
criteria.evidence: 标识符、确认与重试行为。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪提交后但在收到确认前的超时情况；重试必须收敛于一条逻辑记录。

original.criterion: The synchronization design is retry-safe and prevents retransmission from creating duplicate samples or duplicate custody events.
original.grader_hint: Trace a timeout after submission but before receipt of an acknowledgement; a retry must converge on one logical record.

criteria.description: 冲突版本或被拒绝的更新会被呈现出来以进行受控解决，不会通过“最后写入获胜”的行为静默解决。
criteria.evidence: 冲突与异常处理。
criteria.grader_hint: 当两个状态无法自动合并时，查找对证据的保留以及一个可问责的解决路径。

original.criterion: Conflicting versions or rejected updates are surfaced for controlled resolution and are not silently resolved by last-write-wins behavior.
original.grader_hint: Look for preservation of both evidence and an accountable resolution path when two states cannot be merged automatically.

criteria.description: 实验室流量经过整合，以确保所选架构不超过 Drakemoor Supply 的两个并发外部 API 会话的限制。
criteria.evidence: 集成拓扑与连接管理说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪所有十二个作业组至实验室边界，并验证并发数被集中限制为两个或更少的会话。

original.criterion: Laboratory traffic is consolidated so that the selected architecture cannot exceed Drakemoor Supply’s limit of two concurrent external API sessions.
original.grader_hint: Trace all twelve crews to the lab boundary and verify that concurrency is centrally bounded at two or fewer sessions.

criteria.description: 该架构考虑到实验室会话在其提交的批次得到确认之前保持占用状态。
criteria.evidence: 队列、工作器或会话生命周期。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证容量计算未假设会话在传输后立即变为空闲。

original.criterion: The architecture accounts for a laboratory session remaining occupied until its submitted batch is acknowledged.
original.grader_hint: Verify that capacity is not calculated as if a session became free immediately after transmission.

criteria.description: 持久队列或等效缓冲区控制实验室背压，而不阻塞断连期间的现场捕获或丢失已接受的现场记录。
criteria.evidence: 集成组件职责与故障流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估在确认缓慢或实验室接口不可用时的行为；现场记录必须保持受控且可恢复。

original.criterion: A durable queue or equivalent buffer controls laboratory back-pressure without blocking disconnected field capture or losing accepted field records.
original.evidence: Integration component responsibilities and failure flow.
original.grader_hint: Assess behavior during slow acknowledgements or an unavailable lab interface; field records must remain controlled and recoverable.

criteria.description: 设计区分了本地接受、中央同步、提交至实验室和由实验室确认的状态或等效的生命周期状态。
criteria.evidence: 状态模型与操作流程。
criteria.grader_hint: 用户或操作员必须能够判断记录是仅存在于本地还是实际上已被 Drakemoor 接受。

original.criterion: The design distinguishes locally accepted, centrally synchronized, submitted-to-lab and acknowledged-by-lab states or equivalent lifecycle states.
original.grader_hint: A user or operator must be able to tell whether a record merely exists locally or has actually been accepted by Drakemoor.

criteria.description: 实验室验证失败、模式错误和不可用的确认进入可见的重试或隔离处理流程并指定责任人，而不是消失或被报告为成功。
criteria.evidence: 异常路径与路线图所有权。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找受控的错误状态、保留的证据以及负责解决的具名角色。

original.criterion: Laboratory validation failures, schema errors and unavailable acknowledgements enter visible retry or quarantine handling with ownership, rather than disappearing or being reported as successful.
original.grader_hint: Look for a controlled error state, retained evidence and a named role responsible for resolution.

criteria.description: 现场客户端、托管本地组件、中央集成服务和实验室之间的访问遵循最小特权原则并按角色分离。
criteria.evidence: 信任边界、身份与授权说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证单个平板电脑或作业组账户的泄露不会自动授予对本地存储或实验室集成的管理权限。

original.criterion: Access between the field client, managed local component, central integration service and laboratory is least-privileged and separated by role.
original.evidence: Trust boundaries, identities and authorization description.
original.grader_hint: Verify that compromise of one tablet or crew account does not automatically grant administration of the local store or laboratory integration.

criteria.description: 持久化样本和保管数据在每个托管存储位置静态加密，并在跨越每个网络边界传输时受到保护。
criteria.evidence: 映射到存储和流的安全控制。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查每个持久化存储和网络跳点，而不仅仅是中央平台。

original.criterion: Persistent sample and custody data is encrypted at rest in each managed storage location and protected in transit across each network boundary.
original.evidence: Security controls mapped to stores and flows.
original.grader_hint: Check every persistent store and network hop, not just the central platform.

criteria.description: 密钥和凭据处理涵盖预配、轮换或替换、吊销和恢复，且不在 BYOD 平板电脑上放置主秘密。
criteria.evidence: 密钥管理与运营控制说明。
criteria.grader_hint: 认可相称的生命周期；拒绝那些在丢失一个设备或凭据后完整性变得永久无法验证的设计。

original.criterion: Key and credential handling addresses provisioning, rotation or replacement, revocation and recovery without placing master secrets on BYOD tablets.
original.grader_hint: Credit a proportionate lifecycle; reject designs whose integrity becomes permanently unverifiable after one device or credential is lost.

criteria.description: 审计证据可作为连贯包导出用于规划调查，包括保管历史、完整性验证以及相关的同步或异常证据。
criteria.evidence: 审计与证据导出设计。
criteria.grader_hint: 评估审查者是否能在无需直接访问现场设备或未记录的操作员知识的情况下重建链条。

original.criterion: Audit evidence can be exported as a coherent package for a planning inquiry, including custody history, integrity verification and relevant synchronization or exception evidence.
original.grader_hint: Assess whether a reviewer could reconstruct the chain without direct access to a field device or undocumented operator knowledge.

criteria.description: 文档包含清晰可读的端到端架构或数据流视图，涵盖现场录入、断连持久化、同步、中央集成和已接受的实验室接收。
criteria.evidence: 渲染后的架构图或等效视觉图。
criteria.grader_hint: 视觉图必须足够清晰地展示组件和有向流，以便追踪一个样本从捕获到确认的过程。

original.criterion: The document includes a legible end-to-end architecture or data-flow view covering field entry, disconnected persistence, synchronization, central integration and accepted laboratory receipt.
original.evidence: Rendered architecture diagram or equivalent visual.
original.grader_hint: The visual must show components and directional flows clearly enough to trace one sample from capture through acknowledgement.

criteria.description: 架构视图标记有意义的信任或管理边界，包括 BYOD、托管现场基础设施、Wrenfell 中央服务和 Drakemoor Supply 之间的区别。
criteria.evidence: 架构视觉图与图例。
criteria.grader_hint: 如果分离是无歧义的，则接受明确的边界线、区域或清晰标注的组件所有权。

original.criterion: The architecture view marks meaningful trust or management boundaries, including the distinction between BYOD, managed field infrastructure, Wrenfell central services and Drakemoor Supply.
original.grader_hint: Accept explicit boundary lines, zones or clearly labeled component ownership if the separation is unambiguous.

criteria.description: 可追溯的决策记录将每个实质性源约束映射到所选架构的一个特性或一个显式限制。
criteria.evidence: 决策理由、约束映射或保证表。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查对广域网丢失、平板电脑无静态数据、混合 BYOD、保管完整性和时间、两个实验室会话、交付能力和动员时间的覆盖情况。

original.criterion: A traceable decision record maps every material source constraint to a feature of the selected architecture or to an explicit limitation.
original.evidence: Decision rationale, constraint mapping or assurance table.
original.grader_hint: Check coverage of WAN loss, no tablet data at rest, mixed BYOD, custody integrity and time, two lab sessions, delivery capacity and mobilisation timing.

criteria.description: 文档明确搁置了直接的按作业组或按平板电脑的实验室连接，因为它们与许可的并发性和可控的集成行为相冲突。
criteria.evidence: 被搁置设计的讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 被拒绝的设计应易于识别，且原因应源自两会话源约束，而非偏好。

original.criterion: The document expressly sets aside direct per-crew or per-tablet laboratory connections because they conflict with licensed concurrency and controllable integration behavior.
original.grader_hint: The rejected design should be recognizable and the reason should follow from the two-session source constraint, not preference.

criteria.description: 文档搁置了仅限云端的现场捕获，因为它无法支持已确认的覆盖条件。
criteria.evidence: 被搁置设计的讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 查找对需要实时广域网访问来记录现场事件的设计的明确拒绝。

original.criterion: The document sets aside cloud-only field capture as incapable of supporting the confirmed coverage conditions.
original.grader_hint: Look for explicit rejection of a design that requires live WAN access to record the field event.

criteria.description: 文档搁置了平板电脑上的持久原生存储，包括其他方面常规的离线优先应用程序，因为它与最终用户设备限制和交付能力相冲突。
criteria.evidence: 被搁置设计的讨论。
criteria.grader_hint: 理由必须联系政策以及显示新的原生跨平台应用程序超出可用实施窗口的源估算。

original.criterion: The document sets aside durable native storage on tablets, including an otherwise conventional offline-first application, because it conflicts with the end-user-device restriction and delivery capacity.
original.grader_hint: The rationale must connect both policy and the source estimate showing a new native cross-platform application is outside the available implementation window.

criteria.description: 所选方法可在两名集成工程师各六周以及八天安全架构师评审内实现，而不是假设源排除的教科书式全新构建。
criteria.evidence: 工作量分配、复用假设与路线图。
criteria.grader_hint: 审查计划中对提供的现有能力的可信复用，并确保分配的工作不超过所述容量。

original.criterion: The selected approach is achievable within two integration engineers for six weeks each and eight security-architect review days, rather than assuming the textbook greenfield build that the source rules out.
original.evidence: Effort allocation, reuse assumptions and roadmap.
original.grader_hint: Review the plan for credible reuse of the supplied existing capabilities and ensure assigned work does not exceed the stated capacities.

criteria.description: 路线图按依赖感知顺序排列架构保证、配置或实施、集成、安全评审、现场验证、就绪和动员。
criteria.evidence: 路线图日期、依赖关系与里程碑。
criteria.grader_hint: 检查前置工作在依赖测试或发布前已完成；仅有标签是不够的。

original.criterion: The roadmap sequences architecture assurance, configuration or implementation, integration, security review, field validation, readiness and mobilisation in a dependency-aware order.
original.grader_hint: Check that predecessor work is complete before dependent testing or release; labels alone are insufficient.

criteria.description: 路线图日期尊重 21 十二月至 5 一月的变更冻结期，并在 3 二月 2027 开始现场采样之前达到就绪状态。
criteria.evidence: 带日期的路线图与里程碑逻辑。
criteria.grader_hint: 除非源明确允许，否则不应在冻结期内安排生产变更，且就绪必须在 3 二月之前完成。

original.criterion: Roadmap dates respect the 21 December through 5 January change freeze and culminate in readiness before field sampling begins on 3 February 2027.
original.grader_hint: No production change should be scheduled inside the freeze unless the source explicitly permits it, and readiness must precede 3 February.

criteria.description: 每个实质性路线图活动或里程碑都有一个具体的负责人，该负责人来自源支持的角色或具名利益相关者。
criteria.evidence: 路线图所有权字段。
criteria.grader_hint: 拒绝诸如“团队”这样模糊的所有权表述，因为这会使保证、集成、现场验收或实验室协调的责任归属不明确。

original.criterion: Every material roadmap activity or milestone has a concrete accountable owner drawn from a source-supported role or named stakeholder.
original.grader_hint: Reject vague ownership such as “team” where accountability for assurance, integration, field acceptance or lab coordination would remain unclear.

criteria.description: 验收测试涵盖断网捕获、平板无持久化存储、保管链归属、可信时间降级、篡改检测、重试去重以及双会话实验室限制。
criteria.evidence: 路线图中的测试与验收部分。
criteria.grader_hint: 每个列明的风险必须有可观察的通过或失败证据；通用的系统测试里程碑不满足此项要求。

original.criterion: Acceptance testing covers disconnected capture, absence of tablet persistence, custody attribution, trusted-time degradation, tamper detection, retry deduplication and the two-session laboratory limit.
original.evidence: Test and acceptance portion of the roadmap.
original.grader_hint: Each named risk must have observable pass or fail evidence; a generic system-test milestone does not satisfy this item.

original.criterion: The plan includes a bounded field pilot or rehearsal and an actionable fallback or rollback position that preserves custody evidence if readiness criteria are not met.

criteria.description: 预测的未来结果必须与明确的、有来源支持的假设相关联，并至少包括正常的断网运行案例以及诸如长时间广域网中断或实验室确认延迟等降级案例。

original.criterion: The chosen numerical planning baseline is internally consistent across the recommendation, diagram, capacity discussion and roadmap, including twelve crews, eighteen first-wave sites, the fleet figures, two lab sessions and the stated delivery capacity wherever those figures are used.
original.evidence: All numerical statements in the document.
original.grader_hint: Cross-check repeated figures and any derived allocations. Allow omission where a figure is irrelevant, but not contradictory scale assumptions.

criteria.description: 渲染后的文档在页数上限内连贯、清晰且可执行：顺序易于跟随，图表和表格保持可读，同行评审人员无需询问作者即可识别决策、控制措施、所有权和时间安排。
criteria.evidence: 整个渲染后的文档。

original.criterion: The rendered document is coherent, legible and executable under the page cap: sequencing is easy to follow, diagrams and tables remain readable, and a peer reviewer can identify the decision, controls, ownership and timing without asking the author to interpret it.
original.grader_hint: Judge professional usability as a whole, including hierarchy, transitions, visual legibility and whether critical qualifications are discoverable.

criteria.description: 文档选择、推荐或暗示背书某个新的具名产品，或将未经证实的成本、人员配置水平、吞吐量、可用性百分比、保留期限、接口能力或供应商承诺作为事实呈现。

original.criterion: The document selects, recommends or implies endorsement of a new named product, or presents an unsupported cost, staffing level, throughput, availability percentage, retention period, interface capability or vendor commitment as fact.

original.grader_hint: Apply once if any prohibited invented commitment or figure is used to support the decision. Generic component types and clearly labeled non-numeric uncertainties are not violations.

spec.professional_context: Wrenfell Geoenvironmental is mobilising a multi-year remediation programme whose disconnected field operations, custody obligations, mixed device estate and licensed laboratory interface require a bounded architecture decision. The document will be challenged by Malachy Oyelaran and technical assurance peers before implementation begins.
difficulty_sources: The word “offline” has two materially different stakeholder meanings that must be defined before it can support a decision.
Disconnected operation and a prohibition on sample data at rest on end-user devices must be reconciled through a defensible trust boundary.
Tamper-evident custody timestamps must survive loss of WAN and trusted external time without overstating what integrity evidence proves.
A two-session laboratory licence conflicts with per-crew integration at twelve-crew scale.
Mixed BYOD prevents reliance on uniform endpoint management.
Limited engineering capacity and a change freeze make a greenfield native application infeasible, requiring a supportable fallback using available capabilities.
The deliverable must transform correspondence into a single architecture, dependent control model, projected scenarios and executable roadmap under an eight-page cap.

reference_file.form: A concise, internally consistent collection of dated emails and message excerpts from the named stakeholders, with quoted policy text and confirmed technical facts distinguishable from preferences.
required_facts: Wrenfell Geoenvironmental has a four-year remediation framework for Sheafield Mutual, with field sampling beginning 3 February 2027.
The first wave has twelve crews and eighteen sites; crews relocate every three to ten days.
Fourteen sites have no dependable cellular coverage and four have intermittent service; crews must operate through a full disconnected shift.

The field team uses “offline” to mean no WAN dependency, while security discussion sometimes uses it to mean no persistent sample data on the tablet. The source must expose both usages without resolving the architecture.

Sheafield policy prohibits sample identifiers, locations, observations and custody records at rest on an end-user device. A clarification allows persistence in approved managed infrastructure when encrypted and access-logged.
The fleet contains twenty managed tablets and twenty-eight personally owned Android and iPad devices. BYOD devices cannot be enrolled in Wrenfell MDM.
The current browser-based field form and an existing approved managed-edge image are available for configuration; the source must not name a commercial edge product.

Drakemoor Supply’s laboratory interface allows no more than two concurrent external API sessions. A session remains occupied until the submitted batch is acknowledged. Queued batch submission and status retrieval are supported.
Cecilia Gasparyan prefers direct tablet-to-lab submission as a simplification, but her statement is a preference rather than a controlling requirement.
Custody evidence may be produced in a planning inquiry. Every event needs sample identity, actor, action or transfer and event time.
Sheafield requires UTC event times at one-second resolution. Users can alter tablet clocks, and no external time service is guaranteed during a site outage.
Two integration engineers are available for six weeks each and the security architect for eight review days before mobilisation.

A new native cross-platform capture application is estimated beyond the available capacity even before validation. Configuration of the current browser form and approved managed-edge image fits within the available window if the architecture uses them defensibly.
A change freeze runs from 21 December through 5 January.
No source-supported costs, throughput rates, service availability percentages, retention periods or additional vendor commitments are provided.
imperfections: Use the ambiguous term “offline” in stakeholder messages with the two ordinary meanings, requiring the author to define it in the decision document.

Include a senior stakeholder preference for direct tablet-to-lab integration even though the confirmed two-session licensing and acknowledgement behavior makes that topology unsuitable at twelve-crew scale.
Present the no-at-rest rule and disconnected-working need in separate messages so the practitioner must identify the managed local infrastructure boundary that reconciles them.
Present resource estimates and the freeze dates in different messages so roadmap feasibility requires synthesis rather than copying one schedule.

reference_solution.intended_verdict: Recommend one architecture in which managed field infrastructure, not the tablet, is the disconnected system of record. Tablets use a tightly controlled browser session over a local field network without durable sample storage. The managed field component validates and persists records, supplies controlled event time, appends tamper-evident custody events and later synchronizes them to a central integration service. The central service verifies and anchors custody evidence, queues idempotent laboratory batches and limits workers to no more than two acknowledged-session lifecycles at once.
required_reasoning: Define operational offline working separately from tablet data persistence.
Treat BYOD clients as untrusted presentation and input endpoints, not managed storage or custody authorities.
Use stable sample and event identifiers, retry-safe synchronization, explicit lifecycle states and controlled conflict handling.
Use a managed time source at the field component, record drift or uncertainty and avoid claiming that tamper evidence proves the truth of an observation.
Consolidate all laboratory submissions behind centrally bounded queue workers because per-crew connections violate the licensed concurrency model.
Reject cloud-only capture, direct per-crew lab submission and durable native tablet storage for distinct source-grounded reasons.
Prefer configuration and integration of available capabilities over a greenfield native application because the available engineering and security-review capacity makes the textbook build infeasible.
Sequence assurance, configuration, integration, testing, pilot and readiness around the freeze and before 3 February 2027.
gold_relationships: Every architecture component that stores sample data must be inside a managed trust boundary and must have encryption and access logging.
Every custody event must preserve sample identity, actor, action and UTC time at one-second resolution.
The authoritative custody time must not be derived solely from a user-adjustable tablet clock.
A retransmitted logical record must converge on one sample and one event sequence rather than create duplicates.
Laboratory concurrency must never exceed two sessions, and each session remains allocated until acknowledgement.
The roadmap workload assigned to integration engineers must fit within a total of twelve engineer-weeks, and security review must fit within eight days.
No production change may be planned during 21 December through 5 January, and operational readiness must precede 3 February 2027.
Projected outcomes must be conditional on supplied assumptions and must not introduce unsupported quantitative performance claims.
reference_solution.space_feasibility: An eight-page document can accommodate a concise decision summary, one architecture and trust-boundary diagram, a constraint-to-design table, a short designs-set-aside section, controls and failure behavior, a roadmap with owners and dates, acceptance criteria, scenarios and a final decision. The rubric does not require separate prose sections for every control; tables and diagram annotations may satisfy multiple distinct checks without exceeding the cap.

title_original: wrenfell target field data architecture decision
original_instruction:
You’re the information systems manager supporting Wrenfell Geoenvironmental’s mobilisation of the Sheafield Mutual remediation framework, and Malachy Oyelaran needs the target field-data architecture settled before the technical assurance review. The framework runs for four years and field sampling starts on 3 February 2027. Twelve crews will be working across eighteen former industrial sites in the first mobilisation wave, typically relocating every three to ten days. Sheafield’s coverage survey found no dependable cellular service at fourteen of those sites and intermittent service at the other four. Chidi Macaulay’s field team therefore expects to keep recording samples and custody transfers through a full shift without a WAN connection. Sheafield’s information-handling schedule simultaneously says that sample identifiers, locations, observations and chain-of-custody records must not be stored at rest on an end-user device. Its security clarification permits persistence only in approved managed infrastructure with encryption and access logging. The fleet consists of twenty managed tablets and twenty-eight personally owned Android and iPad devices that cannot be enrolled in Wrenfell’s mobile-device management service. The correspondence uses the word “offline” in both operational and security discussions, but not everyone is using it to mean the same thing, so the review team will need to understand exactly what the proposed architecture promises when it uses that term. The source material is collected in `field_architecture_correspondence.pdf`; use that as the factual record for the decision, including the policy wording, stakeholder positions, estate details, interface capabilities and delivery assumptions. Cecilia Gasparyan has asked for direct tablet-to-lab submission because she believes that removes an integration tier, while Kamil Dimitrov has warned that the Drakemoor Supply laboratory system is licensed for no more than two concurrent external API sessions and that a session remains occupied until its batch is acknowledged. Drakemoor supports queued batch submission and status retrieval, but its agreement does not include a separate connection for every crew. Maren Guerrero also needs custody events to remain attributable and tamper-evident through a network outage because records may later be produced in a planning inquiry; a receipt created only after reconnection will not by itself explain who possessed a sample during the disconnected period. Sheafield requires event times in UTC to one-second resolution, but the source notes that tablet clocks can be changed by users and that field locations do not have a guaranteed time service during an outage. The implementation window is constrained as well. Two integration engineers are available for six weeks each before mobilisation, the security architect can provide eight review days, and there is a change freeze from 21 December through 5 January. The estimates in the correspondence put a new native cross-platform capture application beyond that capacity, even before validation, while an existing approved managed-edge image and the current browser-based field form can be configured within the stated window if the architecture can make defensible use of them. Those are planning assumptions rather than permission to ignore testing, operational support or failure handling. The target must cover field capture through accepted receipt in the Drakemoor lab system, including the custody evidence that accompanies that flow. It must work for the mixed fleet without treating a personally owned tablet as managed infrastructure, respect the two-session lab limit, and give the inquiry team evidence whose integrity does not depend on trusting a user-adjustable tablet clock. Several arrangements are technically buildable, but Malachy wants one bounded decision rather than a catalogue of possibilities. He also wants the rejected designs kept visibly separate from the selected target so reviewers can see why apparently simpler choices were not carried forward. The document should turn the choice into an executable roadmap through mobilisation, using the people, capacity, dates and system boundaries actually supported by the correspondence. Project future outcomes under the assumptions in the source and make uncertainty explicit where it affects the plan. Do not invent costs, staffing, throughput, availability percentages, retention periods, interface capabilities or vendor commitments that the source does not provide. Product procurement and commercial renegotiation are outside this decision, and the document should not select or imply endorsement of a new named product. Prepare `target_field_data_architecture.docx` for Malachy and the technical assurance reviewers. Keep it to no more than eight pages in total, including diagrams, tables and appendices, and make it readable as a decision and delivery document rather than a transcript of the messages. It must contain one specific recommended architecture, the designs set aside and the implementation roadmap, with a single numerical planning baseline used consistently wherever the recommendation and roadmap refer to scale or capacity. End on the architecture decision itself, not on a list of questions or generic next steps. Write the file into the top level of the working directory using exactly the filename `target_field_data_architecture.docx`.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/field_architecture_correspondence.pdf` — Consolidated stakeholder correspondence containing the controlling policy language, field conditions, fleet facts, laboratory interface constraints, resource estimates, dates and stakeholder positions for the architecture decision.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `target_field_data_architecture.docx` — A peer-reviewable target field-data architecture decision and executable implementation roadmap covering field capture through accepted laboratory receipt. (Top-level working-directory file; maximum eight pages including diagrams, tables and appendices; exactly one recommended architecture; rejected designs visibly separate; one consistent numerical planning baseline; no invented figures or new named-product selection; conclusion ends on the decision.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
